get_full_annual_cost

Source: R/finance.R
get_full_annual_cost.Rd

get_full_cost() functional calculates the projected annual electricity cost at params$yeartime. Unlike get_annual_cost(), the behavioural costs arising are included.

get_full_annual_cost(
  kWh = 4200,
  tariff_plan,
  phi = 0.4,
  gamma = 2,
  eta = 0.3,
  tau = 36,
  natural_profile = "LP1",
  prices_scen,
  params
)

Arguments

kWh

annual kWh

tariff_plan

tariff plan

phi

inflexible fraction

gamma

dimensionless cost penalty

eta

dimensionless ramping penalty

tau

energy recovery horizon

natural_profile

L1 or LP3 at the moment

prices_scen

price scenario

params

parameters at yeartime

Value

dataframe with cost breakdown

Examples

prices_scen <- set_prices(sD)
params <- scenario_params(sD,2026)
#get_full_annual_cost(8760,"flat",0.4,10,0.3,24,"LP1",prices_scen,params)
get_full_annual_cost(8760,"tou",phi=0.4,gamma=5,eta=0.3,tau=24,"LP1",prices_scen,params)
#>   tariff_plan  kWh phi gamma eta tau annual_bill_inflexible
#> 1         tou 8760 0.4     5 0.3  24               2982.906
#>   annual_bill_flexible fin_gain  penalty  kinetic real_gain
#> 1             2798.388     -185 61.20762 31.03598       -92
#get_full_annual_cost(8760,"dynamic",phi=0.4,gamma=5,eta=0.3,tau=60,"LP1",prices_scen,params)
